messages.text: Trying to find out where my order is this is starting to get really ridiculous. You take peoples money and then you don’t produce the product for months what’s going on here?  Christian S. Filipiak  (phone hidden)
Note to the team: I'll pull up the order before replying.
Handed to the team · Order paid Sep 2, BS-2 line sat on Georges' manual hold ("Sep 23: keep on hold,

Hi Christian,

I'm sorry. You placed Shop···· on September 2, it was paid that day, and nobody has given you a straight answer since. That's on us, and I can see no update was ever sent to you about it.

Here is where it actually stands. Your Bitfortun BS-2 has not shipped. The line is sitting on an internal hold on our side, which is why it never went out with the BitFortun batch, and that hold is not something I can lift from here. I'm not going to give you a ship date I can't stand behind.

I've put this in front of Georges with everything on it. The team is offline this evening and picks it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes straight to you by email, so you don't need to chase it again.

For the wait, I've made you a code that's yours alone: HD-••••••, $25 off a future order over $100.

If you'd rather move that $389 onto a miner we can ship instead, say the word and I'll put the options in front of you with real dates.

Sorry again for the silence, Christian.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah — I don't mind switching the $389 to a miner you can actually
ship. But I'm only interested in BM1373-chip models, and it has to
have an ethernet connection — nothing WiFi-only. What fits that, and
what are the real ship dates? Put the options in front of me.
— Christian F., (phone hidden)
Handed to the team · order_swap lookup refuses: swappable false because of Georges' manual fulfillmen

Hi Christian,

Good, that narrows it nicely. Three of our units run the BM1373 and all three have a wired ethernet port, not WiFi only.

Hammer Miner Thor P2, 10 TH/s, 2x BM1373, about 166 W, $379. Not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by November 3.

Nexus S1, 10 TH/s, 4x BM1373, about 150 W, Mean Well PSU included, $699. Not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by October 29, the earliest date of the three.

Harlo B30, 30 TH/s, BM1373, about 360 to 450 W, $899. Not in stock today, it is a pre-order that ships by November 30. Best value per TH by a distance if you want the bigger unit.

On the money, the $360 you paid on the BS-2 line comes off whichever you choose. So the Thor P2 is roughly $19 more, the Nexus S1 about $339 more, the B30 about $539 more, and I'll give you the exact figure to the cent before anything is charged.

Tell me which one and I'll get it moved onto your order. One thing I'll be straight about: your order still carries that internal hold, and it has to come off before I can make the change. That is with Georges and the team picks it up today at 10am Eastern, so a reply from you now means it gets done as soon as they clear it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah — I'll take the Hammer Thor P2. Can we do an even swap with
no new charge? I paid $389 on the BS-2 and the Thor is $379 — apply
the $25 code you gave me to cover the difference on your books.
Confirm the final numbers to the cent before anything moves, and
process it as soon as the hold clears. One more thing: please confirm
this is something you can actually ship tomorrow — I don't want to
trade one wait for another.
— Christian F., (phone hidden)
Handed to the team · order_swap preview and commit both refuse while Georges' manual hold is on the o

Hi Christian,

Thor P2 it is, and I'd rather give you the real numbers than an easy yes.

The $389 you paid is $359 for the BS-2 line plus $30 shipping, no tax on it. So the comparison is $359 against the Thor P2 at $379, which leaves about $20 for you to pay, not a credit back. Shipping stays as paid, so there is nothing extra there. I'll run the exact figure to the cent and send it to you before a dollar moves, exactly as you asked.

On the code, I have to be straight with you. HD-•••••• is a discount code for a future order at checkout. It cannot be applied to an order already placed, so it won't cover that $20, and I'm not going to pretend otherwise and have it bounce later.

And on shipping tomorrow, no, I can't promise that, and I won't. The T. P2 is not on the shelf today. It is a pre-order that ships by November 3. Nothing we sell with a BM1373 and an ethernet port is in stock for immediate shipping right now, so that is the honest picture across all three units I listed.

If November 3 still works for you, say the word and the swap is ready to go on my side. The only thing in the way is that hold on your order, which is with Georges. The team picks it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and I'll run the change and send you the final numbers the moment it clears.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Sarah — before I say the word on the Thor, one question: the
BitFortun BS-4 is the direct upgrade of the BS-2 I originally ordered.
What's the real ship date on it? And could we run it as a new order
instead of a swap — I'd use the $25 code at checkout, and you'd refund
the $359 credit on the BS-2? What would the final numbers look like?
— Christian F., (phone hidden)
